features.title: Isolate threads in git worktrees
features.summary: As a VCS provider for plain git repositories, create a thread worktree on its own dsh/thread-… branch beside the repository when isolation is switched on, register it as a DSH project, list and remove it.

configuration.constraints: Off answers every provision with the project checkout unchanged.
Empty uses <repository>-threads; ~/ expands to the home directory.

failureModes: git worktree remove refuses a worktree with uncommitted changes unless force is passed.
Removing anything but a thread worktree this plugin created is refused.

externalDependencies.boundary: Fixed-argv git CLI run with execFile; snapshots use a throwaway GIT_INDEX_FILE so the real index and HEAD never move.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Real temporary git repositories in src/git-worktrees.integration.test.ts; no git mock is used.

verification.testName: provisions a thread worktree on its own branch and recognises it
is not a repository outside git and refuses to remove the project checkout

telemetry.testName: is not a repository outside git and refuses to remove the project checkout

features.title: Snapshot and restore a git workspace's files
features.summary: Record every tracked and untracked, non-ignored file as a commit kept under refs/dsh/snapshots/ without moving HEAD or the index, and put the files back to it, returning a snapshot of what they were.
failureModes: A snapshot that is not a commit id is refused before any file changes.
Ignored files are never recorded or touched.

externalDependencies.boundary: Fixed-argv git CLI run with execFile; snapshots use a throwaway GIT_INDEX_FILE so the real index and HEAD never move.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Real temporary git repositories in src/git-worktrees.integration.test.ts; no git mock is used.

verification.testName: restores files to a snapshot and back, leaving the index, HEAD and ignored files alone

telemetry.testName: is not a repository outside git and refuses to remove the project checkout
